text: With 4+ years of experience in Data Engineering, I focus on building scalable data pipelines, reliable data marts, and analytics-ready datasets across cloud environments. I bring strong expertise in Python, PySpark, SQL, GCP BigQuery, Dataform, and ETL/ELT workflows, with a consistent focus on performance, data quality, and stakeholder impact. I am committed to continuous learning and to contributing measurable business value through data-driven solutions.
